title: Recompilation Is Not Enough: Test-Guided Decompiled-C Repair
abstract: arXiv:2609.07201v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decompiled C often becomes recompilable only after repair, but recompilation alone does not establish test-observed behavior. A recompiled command-line binary can still parse options incorrectly, print different bytes, or return a different exit status. We present a few-step workflow for repairing decompiled C using compiler feedback and related official tests. Compiler and linker diagnostics first guide build repair. Once the repaired C recompiles into a binary, smoke checks and related official tests expose behavioral discrepancies for semantic repair. In a preliminary static-enriched evaluation on 104 Coreutils 9.5 binaries with available decompiler exports and deterministic exact-output smoke comparisons, 91 binaries (87.5%) recompile and pass the test gate; 9 do not recompile within the repair budget, and 4 recompile but still fail the test gate. The result suggests that test-gate feedback can make LLM-assisted repair of decompile

translated_title: 重新编译是不够的：测试引导的反编译C代码修复
translated_abstract: 反编译得到的C代码通常只有在经过修复后才能重新编译，但仅靠重新编译并不能建立测试可观察到的行为。一个重新编译成功的命令行二进制文件仍可能错误地解析选项、打印不同的字节，或返回不同的退出状态。我们提出了一种使用编译器反馈和相关官方测试来修复反编译C代码的几步工作流程。编译器和链接器的诊断信息首先用于指导构建修复。一旦修复后的C代码重新编译为二进制文件，冒烟检查和相关官方测试就会暴露行为差异，从而进行语义修复。在对104个具有可用反编译器导出和确定性精确输出冒烟比较的Coreutils 9.5二进制文件进行的初步静态增强评估中，91个二进制文件（87.5%）成功重新编译并通过了测试门；9个在修复预算内未能重新编译，4个虽重新编译但仍未通过测试门。结果表明，测试门反馈能够使LLM辅助的反编译（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 论文提出一种结合编译器反馈与官方测试的几步工作流程，证明重新编译成功并不等于行为正确，通过测试门反馈可引导LLM辅助修复反编译C代码，使91个Coreutils二进制文件（87.5%）同时通过编译和测试验证。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a few-step workflow combining compiler feedback and official tests to repair decompiled C code, showing that successful recompilation does not guarantee correct behavior, and test-gate feedback enables LLM-assisted repair to make 91 Coreutils binaries (87.5%) pass both compilation and behavioral tests.
